answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor appears capable of meeting the spend mandate, but switching primary supply while the line has no buffer could create delivery risk. Verify the vendor’s onboarding and operating record, and the incumbent’s demonstrated ability to move on price and payment terms, before using the quote as leverage to negotiate renewal terms. This preserves integration and delivery continuity while testing whether the incumbent can close enough of the cost gap; the 18% outcome remains uncertain.
